About Me

I'm a data analyst who enjoys the part most people skip — sitting with messy, inconsistent data until it starts making sense. Over the past couple of years I've built a habit of picking up real, sizeable datasets and taking them the full distance: cleaning, modeling, and shaping them into dashboards that a business owner could actually act on, not just admire.

My core toolkit is Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI, and I lean on all four depending on what the data needs — SQL to pull and shape it, Python when the analysis gets exploratory, Excel for fast iteration, and Power BI to turn the result into something leadership can open and understand in thirty seconds. I care more about whether a number is trustworthy than whether a chart looks impressive.

I'm currently pursuing my BCA alongside a structured Data Science training program at Red & White Skill Education, and actively building toward a full-time Data Analyst role — every project on this page is something I built end-to-end, not a tutorial I followed.
